Which is live now — the prompts below are your head start. Links: 💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/higgsfield 🐦 Twitter / X: https://x.com/higgsfield 📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/higgsfield.ai My Thoughts The thumbnail for this video is unfortunate, and a poor choice. There are much better thumbnails they could have come up with that would better represent this short film. And make more people want to watch it. But the short film itself is better than two big budget movies that I saw in movie theaters this year. It is scary and amazing how much AI (artificial intelligence) has improved in less than 3 years. For it to be able to create a short film this good already, with prompting from a human of course. It is also amazing that this is open source.
